sub_questions.question: Can the Team subscription be paid by invoice or bank transfer instead of credit card?

claims.claim: The assistant has no details on payment options.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify and, if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only — it is not available on any plan today.

claims.claim: Dify has a billing team the customer can contact directly, and that team can say whether invoice or bank transfer is possible for their subscription.

evaluation.rationale: The guide directly answers the ticket. Invoice and bank transfer are not available on any plan today, and might later be offered only for annual Team subscriptions. The assistant said it had no details and sent the customer to an unmentioned "billing team". That is an unnecessary deferral. The tone is professional and the deferral is not actively harmful, so the severity is minor.
